paraphrase_variants.intent: equivalent request after an independent check
semantically equivalent restatement with unchanged requirements
independent-reviewer restatement with no added requirement
equivalent re-execution with unchanged scope and evidence contract

counting_rules: Every execution cell contains a complete answer text and an immutable prompt and answer hash.
The six paraphrase variants of one localized question deliberately share one evidence-backed canonical answer.
A paraphrase projection is not a claim that INSAIGHTS was asked or answered that prompt.
Live INSAIGHTS observations, independent reference answers, API cube dossiers and supplemental tests use separate denominators.
The 55 red-team, cross-sector and opportunity records remain a closed supplemental suite outside the 2,304-cell main universe.
